title: [Docs] Feedback
body:
The documentation is gorgeous! Here are a few suggestions that would improve readability IMHO: 1. Decrease padding between header and the start of the content: ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5570853/21102996/d0c5b9b8-c080-11e6-9d71-ce567bdb053b.png) 2. Remove or ligthen the background pattern of the code examples. It looks very nice, but very disturbing when you actually try to read the code: ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5570853/21103016/ef456a64-c080-11e6-8ff6-7a20f4c8b884.png) 3. Increase the `

` line height a bit to make it inline code snippets "breathe": ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5570853/21103080/2bd08612-c081-11e6-9266-989d4ffb78cf.png) 4. Add some padding to the bottom of the sidebar: ![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5570853/21103095/40036f64-c081-11e6-8437-41c555dac6ad.png) WDYT?
